lessons.statement: When instance masks also require imbalanced attribute labels, proposed reuse: Proposed conditional application: Add an attribute head and compare focal loss with the previous attribute loss. lessons.title: Keep standard cross-entropy as a comparator for specialized image losses
lessons.statement: When specialized losses or sampling are proposed for noisy fine-grained images, consider this source-backed action: Compare each alternative with the same cross-entropy baseline and record its actual retention status. Limit: Local negative evidence lacks settings and does not establish universal ineffectiveness.

lessons.title: Align training and selection with a nonstandard metric
lessons.statement: When a weighted competition loss differs materially from ordinary logloss, proposed reuse: Proposed conditional application: Implement the actual metric and compare an aligned training objective with ordinary logloss. Proposed check: Implement metric test fixtures, compare aligned and standard training losses under identical patient folds, and select models by the actual target metric. Limitation: A metric-aligned surrogate may have optimization difficulties; the source comparison is specific to small STRIP AI folds.
